The '''Subtram Hunter gear''' was a type of clothing sold by [[5H-0T]] in the [[Training Room (Jedi Temple)|Training Room]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. It was valued at 80 [[Coruscant Mission Token]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
The Subtram Hunter gear first appeared in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)]]." It is very similar to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] gear he used during the [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|Safe Cargo Objective]].
